note: Cedar County MO has no county planning or zoning (county site notice says third-class county without zoning regulations). El Dorado Springs, the largest city, publishes its City Zoning Map only as a JPG image (images/zonemap.jpg), with no queryable service. Stockton has a planning and zoning commission code chapter but no published zoning GIS layer or map found. ArcGIS search for Cedar County zoning returned no district layers.
